RagShortTexts: The Secret Hand is the largest criminal organization in the Southern Empire, controlling rural towns.

Variants.Content: The Secret Hand is the most powerful criminal organization in the Southern Empire, controlling the countryside and some towns in the southern Empire. On the surface, they are running legitimate businesses, but secretly they handle shady things for the powerful - suppressing riots, silencing people, and looting caravans. It is said that their leader never shows his true face to others and only gives orders in the image of a decent businessman.

In the Southern Empire, no one does not know the Secret Hand. They are serious businessmen during the day, but become another kind of people at night. The dignitaries of the Southern Empire need someone to do their dirty work for them, and Secret Hand is the best choice. They take money to do things and never say anything. But if you get in their way... then you may never get in anyone's way again.

The Secret Hand is a cancer in the Southern Empire and a handy tool. This is a contradiction, but it is true. Where the laws of the empire cannot be dealt with, the hands of secrets are in charge; where the imperial army cannot come forward, the hands of secrets are done. But this also means that the order of the Southern Empire relies on this group of criminals to a certain extent. This is a dangerous game, and if you don't play it well, you'll get burned.

When doing business in the Southern Empire, the most feared thing is the hands of secrets. You are opening a shop in the city, and suddenly one day, a well-dressed man walks in, smiles at you and says: 'The boss said he wants this batch of goods. 'You can only nod and say thank you. They are on the same side as the government and you cannot afford to offend them.

In all my years as a soldier, I have never met the leader of the Secret Hand. It is said that he always wears decent business clothes and no one can recognize him in the crowd. Some say he lived in Lycaron, others in a manor in the country. But everyone knows one thing - his orders are more effective than those of some lords.

Working for the secret hand will make you money quickly, but your life will be short. I know a mercenary who helped them rob caravans twice. On the third trip, what came to join him was not money, but a knife. They don't like to be left alive. If you're short of money, find work elsewhere, and don't get into the Secret Hand business.

The Secret Hand is a monster growing out of the cracks in the imperial order. When a country's laws cannot cover the entire territory and when powerful people need to bypass the law to act, this type of organization will fill the gap. They were not the cause of the decline of the empire but the symptoms of it.

Those people in the Southern Empire can't even handle the security of their own countryside, leaving it to a group of ruffians to have the final say. What baron in our Vlandia would hang such a man at the city gate. The Imperial people always laugh at us as barbarians, but what about their own laws? Can't control a group of criminals wearing businessmen's clothes.

Secret Hand? Just a Southern rat. In our north, such organizations are either recruited by Boyer as thugs or eliminated. It's a shame that the gentlemen of the Southern Empire allowed them to control half of the countryside.

There is no such thing as a secret hand in Battania. Our enemies are visible - the legions of the Empire, the knights of Vlandia. The people of the Southern Empire even hide their enemies under decent clothes, and they live too tiredly.

The Southern Empire has the Secret Hand, and we Aserai have the Sons of Shadow. Both are knives hidden in the shadows, but the Shadow Children are part of the desert tradition, while the Secret Hand is more a product of the decay of the Empire. When the law doesn't work, the criminal becomes the law.

The Sons of Shadow collect protection fees in the desert, but at least they have their own rules. What about the secret hand? They have no rules, just business. The Imperials always say we are barbaric, but at least we know who to fear. In the Southern Empire, you don’t even know who to fear.

There is no such organization hiding under the robe on the prairie. Our grievances were settled on horseback. The Southern Empire likes to hide everything—hiding their crimes, hiding their enemies, hiding their true leader.

The existence of the Secret Hand is essentially evidence of the failure of governance in the Southern Empire. A healthy country would not allow criminal organizations to take control of its villages and towns. But the powerful people in the Southern Empire chose to exploit them rather than eradicate them. This short-sighted strategy solved the problem in the short term, but made the empire lose the trust of the people in the long term. When people no longer believe in the law and instead believe in the gang's 'rules', that country is not far from collapse.
